asymmetric_pattern_note: The two transportation-ancestors (Murray, Ryan) are critique-and-rescued; the three presence-theorists (Slater, Witmer+Singer, Lombard+Ditton) are displaced-and-replaced; the five game-studies absorption-theorists (McMahan, Salen+Zimmerman, Douglas+Hargadon, Brown+Cairns, Ermi+Mäyrä) are critique-and-superseded. The three-way taxonomy mirrors Calleja's view of which prior contributions deserve preservation, which require displacement, and which contain rescuable partial insights surrounded by replaceable apparatus.

expected_models_absent_from_calleja.name: Csikszentmihalyi (flow)
expected_models_absent_from_calleja.verdict: zero hits in text, references, index

models.prior_claim_summary: Deep immersion / immersion-as-transportation: sensation of being transported into an elaborately simulated place, intensified by interactivity.
models.calleja_response_summary: Transportation-vocabulary replaced; underlying intuition (being-transported-into-a-place) preserved and reconstituted in Ch.10 as incorporation's habitation-metaphor.
models.incorporation_recasts: transportation becomes one axis of the bidirectional double-axis structure (R1 assimilation + R2 embodiment)

models.prior_claim_summary: Spatial / textual-world immersion: representation of inhabitable space is the defining feature of immersion-suitable media (spatial/temporal/emotional modes).
models.calleja_response_summary: Quoted approvingly at pp.31-32 against Salen+Zimmerman's Tetris move; spatiality-as-defining-feature preserved and elevated to incorporation's spatial+kinesthetic cornerstone.
models.incorporation_refuses: the 'plunge into a textual world' unidirectionality
models.incorporation_recasts: spatial immersion becomes the SPATIAL dimension of the PIM, gated by cornerstone-pair requirement

models.work: FIVE framework + Note on Presence Terminology
models.calleja_response_summary: Sustained critique. Form/content partition rejected. 'Rejection of technological determinism' explicit at IG-10 p.173: a tabletop board game can be more incorporating than low-fidelity VR.
models.incorporation_recasts: subjective disposition (not technological envelopment) as constitutive condition

models.prior_claim_summary: Immersion as psychological state of envelopment; presence = involvement + immersion; presence-questionnaire as measurement instrument.
models.calleja_response_summary: Symptomatic of presence-theory's terminological confusion (psychological-envelopment inverts Slater+Wilbur's hardware-immersion). Envelopment-as-submersion is the canonical 'unidirectional plunge' critique target.
models.incorporation_recasts: single-direction envelopment replaced by bidirectional double-axis incorporation

models.work: At the Heart of It All
models.prior_claim_summary: Presence as 'perceptual illusion of non-mediation'; six characterizations of presence (transportation, realism, immersion, social actor within medium, etc.).
models.calleja_response_summary: Praised for synthetic move but critiqued via McMahan's failed Myst III application: operationalized, the framework reduces to feature-list pigeonholing. Intrusion-integration thesis refuses illusion-of-non-mediation.
models.incorporation_recasts: the six characterizations replaced by the six PIM dimensions (a different six, grounded in involvement rather than presence-feature)

models.work: Immersion, Engagement and Presence (Myst III analysis)
models.prior_claim_summary: Perceptual / psychological / social-realism three-fold immersion, operationalized on Myst III: Exile.
models.calleja_response_summary: Social-realism claims apply trivially to most digital games in similar genres, doing no game-specific work. McMahan drifts terminologically (immersion as form of involvement). Category-checklist style incompatible with multidimensional non-monolithic incorporation.
models.incorporation_recasts: three-fold classification superseded by the six-dimensional PIM

models.prior_claim_summary: The 'immersive fallacy' (mimetic-realism as design desideratum) is wrong; absorption-style immersion is observable in non-spatial games (Tetris).
models.calleja_response_summary: Partial endorsement of anti-mimetic-realism stance; partial critique of Tetris-as-immersion move (sidelines spatiality; conflates absorption with transportation). Tetris is acknowledged as absorption-style involvement but excluded from incorporation by cornerstone-pair requirement.
models.incorporation_refuses: Tetris-as-immersion (Tetris lacks habitable space, fails spatial+kinesthetic cornerstone)
models.incorporation_recasts: the 'immersive fallacy' framing superseded by six-dimensional PIM

models.work: The Pleasures of Immersion and Engagement
models.prior_claim_summary: Immersion (within-frame schema) vs engagement (extra-textual stance); attentional continuum; collapses ergodic/non-ergodic distinction.
models.calleja_response_summary: Attentional-continuum insight rescued (carried forward into macro/micro phases + sustainment-but-fleeting). Ergodic/non-ergodic collapse refused: 'My definition and description of incorporation precludes its application to any non-ergodic media' (IG-10 p.173).
models.incorporation_recasts: within-frame/extra-textual distinction superseded by multidimensional PIM; books/films return to different theoretical category

models.work: A Grounded Investigation of Immersion in Games
models.prior_claim_summary: Engagement / engrossment / total-immersion three-degree ladder; levels 1-2 = absorption; level 3 = transportation = presence.
models.calleja_response_summary: Continuum-of-attentional-intensity insight rescued; ladder critiqued for mixing metaphors (absorption levels 1-2 + transportation level 3) within a single typology.
models.incorporation_absorbs: continuum-of-involvement insight (preserved as macro/micro + multidim PIM)
models.incorporation_recasts: three-degree ladder replaced by 6-dim × 2-phase grid culminating in incorporation (single-coherent metaphor)

models.work: Fundamental Components of the Gameplay Experience (SCI model)
models.prior_claim_summary: Multidimensional gameplay-experience model — sensory / challenge-based / imaginative immersion (empirically derived from child interviews).
models.calleja_response_summary: Multidimensionality + medium-specificity acknowledged contribution. Method critique: deriving 'immersion' from child interviews collapses academic-technical sense into colloquial sense.
models.incorporation_absorbs: multidimensionality + medium-specificity (sensory ≈ kinesthetic+spatial; challenge-based ≈ kinesthetic+ludic; imaginative ≈ narrative+spatial+affective)
models.incorporation_refuses: the SCI three-mode taxonomy as such; the term 'immersion' for the phenomenon (Calleja relabels involvement)
models.incorporation_recasts: three-mode SCI expanded to six dimensions with addition of SHARED + separation of AFFECTIVE from imaginative
